**Pre-release, eCash betanet only.** Don't use it with coins that have real value.

## Install

**Brave, Chrome, Edge (any Chromium browser)**

1. Download `ecx-wallet-chromium-….zip` below and unzip it into a folder you'll keep (the browser loads the extension from that folder, so don't delete it).
2. Open `brave://extensions` (or `chrome://extensions`, `edge://extensions`).
3. Turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
4. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.

To update: unzip the new version over the same folder, then click the reload arrow on the extension's card. Your wallet stays.

**Firefox**

This build isn't signed by Mozilla yet, so Firefox only keeps it until you restart the browser.

1. Download `ecx-wallet-firefox-….zip` below.
2. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`.
3. Click **Load Temporary Add-on…** and pick the zip.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksum of each zip.
